decimal_derivation.quantile_proof.closed_form_method: Abramowitz & Stegun 26.7.3 (odd df) / 26.7.4 (even df) finite closed form, inverted by bisection; pi by Machin's formula
decimal_derivation.quantile_proof.bounds_origin: issuer-declared bounds, stated in the pre-registration's quantile-proof clause and recorded here in the candidate: a forward residual of at most 1e-30 and agreement of at least 30 significant digits between the two routes, each chosen tighter than the 20 published digits the artifact records and looser than the agreement the implementation realizes
